meta.method: GA4 weekly users are deduplicated: one report call per Mon-Sun week with no date dimension, never summed from daily rows. Bookings = eventCount where eventName EXACTLY 'sevenrooms_booking_complete'. Google bookings use metrics.all_conversions filtered to conversion action 'Hutong Dubai (web) sevenrooms_booking_complete'. Meta bookings = schedule_total (= offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_custom on this account). trend8/funnel spend and bookings = Meta + Google combined. funnel.landing = GA4 Paid Search + Paid Social sessions. Walk-in = Store visits + Local actions - Directions + Local actions - Menu views + Click Book Now + Clicks to call.
